# Medical Bill Dispute Pro

> Medical Bill Dispute Pro helps people check medical bills for billing errors and generate formal dispute letters. Flat $29 per letter. It is a software tool, not a law firm or billing advocate.

## How-to guides
- [How to Dispute a Medical Bill, Step by Step](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/how-to-dispute-a-medical-bill): Learn how to dispute a medical bill step by step: get the itemized bill, compare it to your EOB, call billing, and send a written dispute.
- [How to Request an Itemized Medical Bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/how-to-request-itemized-medical-bill): Ask for an itemized medical bill in writing, know what it should show, and learn what to check line by line before you pay or dispute a charge.
- [How to Read an Explanation of Benefits (EOB)](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/how-to-read-an-eob): An EOB is not a bill. Learn what each line means, how to find your patient responsibility, and how to compare the EOB with the provider's bill.
- [How to Write a Medical Bill Dispute Letter](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/how-to-write-a-medical-bill-dispute-letter): Write a clear medical bill dispute letter: what to include, how to structure it, what to attach, and what to leave out, with practical tips.
- [Medical Bill Dispute Deadlines: Where They Come From](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-deadlines): There is no single federal deadline for disputing a medical bill. See where your real deadlines come from and how to protect your rights.
- [How to Negotiate a Medical Bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/how-to-negotiate-a-medical-bill): Learn how to negotiate a medical bill: fix errors first, ask about assistance and prompt-pay discounts, set up a payment plan, and get it in writing.
- [How to Apply for Hospital Financial Assistance](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/hospital-financial-assistance-application): How to apply for hospital financial assistance or charity care: find the policy, gather documents, apply, and know what 501(r) requires of nonprofits.
- [How to Request Medical Records for a Billing Dispute](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/request-medical-records-for-billing-dispute): Use your HIPAA right of access to request medical and billing records. What to ask for, how to write the request, and how to use them in a dispute.
- [How to File a Medical Billing Complaint With Your State Regulator](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/file-complaint-state-insurance-commissioner): Know where to file a medical billing complaint: state insurance department, attorney general, CMS No Surprises Help Desk, or CFPB. Steps included.
- [How to Dispute a Bill Using the Good Faith Estimate](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/good-faith-estimate-dispute): If your final bill is $400 or more above a good faith estimate, you may use the federal dispute process. Learn who qualifies and how to prepare.
- [What to Do Before a Medical Bill Goes to Collections](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/what-to-do-before-medical-bill-goes-to-collections): Steps to take before a medical bill goes to collections: call billing, ask for a hold, dispute in writing, seek assistance, and arrange a payment plan.
- [Should You Pay a Medical Bill While You Dispute It?](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/should-i-pay-a-medical-bill-while-disputing): Should you pay a medical bill while disputing it? Weigh partial payment, payment plans, written disputes, and asking for a hold, with practical steps.
- [Medical Bill Dispute Checklist: Documents, Calls, and Timeline](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-checklist): A practical medical bill dispute checklist: documents to gather, what to log on every call, and a simple timeline to follow from first review.

## Billing errors
- [Duplicate Charges on a Medical Bill: How to Spot Them and Dispute Them](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/duplicate-charges-medical-bill): Seeing the same charge twice on a medical bill? Learn how duplicate charges happen, how to confirm them with your EOB and records, and how to dispute them.
- [Upcoding in Medical Billing: What It Is and How to Dispute It](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/upcoding-medical-billing): Upcoding means being billed for a higher level of service than you received. See how to compare your bill to your records and dispute a coding level in writing.
- [Unbundling in Medical Billing: When Separate Charges Should Be One](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/unbundling-medical-billing): Unbundling means billing separately for services that belong together. Learn the warning signs on an itemized bill and how to request a coding review.
- [Balance Billing Explained: When It Is Allowed, When It Is Banned](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/balance-billing): Balance billing is when a provider bills you the gap between its charge and what insurance paid. See when it is banned and what to do if you get one.
- [Surprise Medical Bills and the No Surprises Act: What Is Covered](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/surprise-medical-bill): Got an unexpected out-of-network bill? See what the No Surprises Act covers, what it leaves out, and the steps to dispute a surprise medical bill.
- [Charged for Services or Supplies You Never Received: How to Dispute](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/charged-for-services-not-received): Billed for a test, supply, or visit you never had? Learn how to request records, compare them to your bill, and dispute charges for services not received.
- [Billed After Insurance Already Paid: What to Check and What to Do](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/billed-after-insurance-paid): Got a bill after your insurer already paid? Compare it to your EOB, find the mismatch, and ask the provider for a corrected statement before you pay.
- [Wrong Date, Quantity, Units, or Patient on a Medical Bill: How to Catch Errors](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/incorrect-quantity-or-units-medical-bill): Clerical errors like a wrong date, quantity, units, or patient can inflate a medical bill. Learn how to catch them and ask for a corrected statement.

## Billing situations
- [Is your emergency room bill too high? What to check first](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/er-bill-too-high): An emergency room visit can generate a facility bill, a physician bill and separate lab charges. Learn what to check, what to ask, and how to dispute errors.
- [You went to an in-network hospital but got an out-of-network bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/out-of-network-bill-at-in-network-hospital): Billed by an out-of-network doctor after care at an in-network hospital? See how the No Surprises Act applies and how to check, question and dispute the bill.
- [Disputing a ground ambulance bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/ambulance-bill-dispute): Ground ambulance bills are not covered by the federal No Surprises Act. See what still helps: plan appeals, state rules, itemized bills and negotiation.
- [Disputing an air ambulance bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/air-ambulance-bill-dispute): Air ambulance services are covered by the federal No Surprises Act. Learn what to check on the bill and EOB, who to call, and how to dispute the charge.
- [How to dispute a laboratory or diagnostic bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/lab-bill-dispute): Surprised by a lab bill? Learn how to spot duplicate panels, repeated blood-draw fees and network problems, and how to dispute them.
- [Disputing a durable medical equipment (DME) bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/dme-bill-dispute): Disputing a bill from a medical equipment supplier? Check rental versus purchase charges, authorization, quantities and insurer payments.
- [Disputing a medical bill when you are uninsured or self-pay](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/uninsured-self-pay-medical-bill): Uninsured or self-pay and facing a big bill? Learn about good faith estimates, the federal dispute process, financial assistance and prompt-pay negotiation.
- [A surprise bill from an anesthesiologist or other ancillary provider](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/anesthesiologist-surprise-bill): Got a separate bill from an anesthesiologist or other ancillary provider? See how the No Surprises Act may apply and the steps to check and dispute the charge.
- [Your medical bill was sent to collections: what to do next](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-sent-to-collections): A medical bill in collections can still be disputed. Learn how FDCPA validation works, what to put in writing, and where to complain, without panic.
- [Insurance denied your claim and the provider is billing you](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/insurance-denied-claim-medical-bill): Insurer denied a claim and the provider is billing you? Learn how to read the denial, appeal, request external review and ask for a hold.
- [Medicare or Medicaid patient and got a billing error](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medicare-medicaid-billing-errors): Billing errors can happen with Medicare and Medicaid too. Learn how to read your Medicare Summary Notice, Medicaid billing limits, and who to call for help.
- [A separate radiologist or pathologist bill after a hospital visit](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/radiology-pathology-bill-dispute): Why a radiologist or pathologist bills separately after a hospital visit, and how to check it against your EOB, network status and the No Surprises Act.

## Sample letters
- [Sample Letter to Dispute a Duplicate Charge on a Medical Bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/sample-letter-duplicate-charge): A free sample letter for disputing a duplicate charge on a medical bill, with placeholders, tips for customizing it, and what to attach before you send.
- [Sample Letter Disputing Balance Billing and Surprise Out-of-Network Charges](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/sample-letter-balance-billing): Sample letter for disputing a balance bill or surprise out-of-network charge under the No Surprises Act, with customization tips and what to attach.
- [Sample Letter Requesting an Itemized Medical Bill](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/sample-letter-itemized-bill-request): Free sample letter asking a hospital or doctor's office for an itemized medical bill, plus what to request, how to send it, and what to check when it arrives.
- [Sample Letter Disputing a Coding Level (Possible Upcoding)](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/sample-letter-upcoding): Sample letter questioning a medical bill's coding level when you think a visit was billed higher than the care you received, with tips and what to attach.
- [Sample Debt Validation Letter to a Medical Collector](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/sample-letter-collections-validation): Sample debt validation letter to a collection agency for a medical bill under the FDCPA, with timing notes, what to include, and what happens next.
- [Sample Letter Requesting Hospital Financial Assistance](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/sample-letter-financial-assistance-request): Sample letter asking a hospital for its financial assistance policy and an application, with documents to gather and what to expect from nonprofit hospitals.

## Guides & explainers
- [The No Surprises Act Explained: What It Covers and What It Doesn't](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/no-surprises-act-explained): What the No Surprises Act covers, what it does not (including ground ambulances), who is protected, and how to use it when you get a surprise medical bill.
- [Medical Billing Terms: A Plain-Language Glossary](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-billing-glossary): Plain-language glossary of medical billing terms: EOB, CPT, deductible, coinsurance, allowed amount, balance billing, itemized bill, and more.
- [Medical Billing Advocate vs. Attorney vs. DIY Dispute Letter](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-billing-advocate-vs-dispute-letter): An honest comparison of hiring a medical billing advocate, a healthcare attorney, or using a DIY or software dispute letter, with tradeoffs and when each fits.
- [EOB vs. Medical Bill: What Each One Is and Which to Pay](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/eob-vs-medical-bill): An EOB is not a bill. Learn how an Explanation of Benefits, a provider bill, and a statement differ, how to compare them, and which one to pay.
- [Common Medical Billing Errors and Where to Look for Each](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/common-medical-billing-errors): A practical overview of common medical billing errors, such as duplicates, upcoding, unbundling and wrong dates, and where to find each on your bill and EOB.
- [When a DIY Dispute Letter Is Not Enough: Signs You Need a Healthcare Attorney](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/when-you-need-a-healthcare-attorney): When a DIY dispute letter is not enough: lawsuits, large balances, fraud allegations, bankruptcy, and how to find help with a medical bill problem.

## Dispute a bill by state
- [How to Dispute a Medical Bill in Georgia](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-georgia): Disputing a medical bill in Georgia: who to contact at the Insurance Commissioner's office and Attorney General, which federal rules apply, and first steps.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in Texas](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-texas): Texas medical bill dispute guide: figure out your plan type first, then use the Texas Department of Insurance, the Attorney General, or federal help.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in Florida](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-florida): Florida medical bill disputes: how the Office of Insurance Regulation, Department of Financial Services helpline and Attorney General differ, plus federal law.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in California: Which Regulator Is Yours?](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-california): California medical bill disputes: learn whether the Department of Managed Health Care or the Department of Insurance oversees your plan, plus federal rules.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in New York](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-new-york): New York medical bill disputes: how the Department of Financial Services and Attorney General fit with the No Surprises Act, appeals and external review.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in Illinois: Build Your Paper Trail](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-illinois): Illinois medical bill dispute guide built around a paper trail: what to document, when to contact the Department of Insurance or Attorney General.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in Pennsylvania, Starting With the Hospital](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-pennsylvania): Pennsylvania medical bill disputes with a hospital focus: nonprofit hospital financial assistance, the Insurance Department, Attorney General and federal rules.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in Ohio, Especially When Collectors Call](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-ohio): Ohio medical bill disputes with a collections focus: how to dispute a collector in writing, plus the Department of Insurance, Attorney General and CFPB.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in North Carolina, Including Self-Pay and Medicaid](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-north-carolina): North Carolina medical bill disputes with a self-pay angle: good faith estimates, financial assistance, the Department of Insurance, Attorney General, Medicaid.
- [Disputing a Medical Bill in Michigan: Start With Your Records](https://medicalbilldisputepro.com/medical-bill-dispute-michigan): Michigan medical bill disputes using a records-first approach: HIPAA requests, the Department of Insurance and Financial Services and the Attorney General.
